criteria.no: The statement introduces or changes at least one substantive policy, mechanism, strength, condition, or outcome not supported by the quote.
criteria.unclear: The quote has genuinely competing meanings, so unsupported addition cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The statement is a semantic paraphrase or atomic subset of the quote and introduces no new substantive policy, mechanism, strength, condition, or outcome.

faithful-r4-a-no-unsupported-addition.instructions: Narrow fidelity check: does anchor.statement avoid adding any substantive obligation that is absent from anchor.quote? Answer yes for a formal paraphrase even when the shared requirement is vague, the quote says should/need rather than must, common equivalent terms are used, or the statement isolates one directive from a longer quote. Other questions judge quality and completeness.

criteria.no: Even after ordinary normalization, the statement requires a new policy, implementation choice, strength, trigger, or outcome.
criteria.unclear: Ordinary normalization does not settle whether the meaning was preserved.
criteria.yes: Those normalization rules are sufficient and no substantive requirement was invented.

faithful-r4-b-formal-paraphrase.instructions: Is anchor.statement a faithful formal requirement derived from anchor.quote? Preserve meaning, not wording: informal directives may become must, print may become emit to stdout, machine-readable JSON may become JSON, and one directive in a compound quote may become one anchor. Do not penalize vagueness here.

criteria.no: At least one substantive element of the statement is absent from or conflicts with the quote.
criteria.unclear: The quote is too ambiguous to decide whether all statement elements are supported.
criteria.yes: Every substantive element of the statement is supported by the quote, although the quote may say more.

faithful-r4-c-semantic-subset.instructions: Does the substantive obligation in anchor.statement form a supported semantic subset of anchor.quote? The quote may contain additional independent directives. A repeated vague term is still faithful to itself; testability is judged elsewhere.

anchor.quote: only publish after the release lead says yes
anchor.statement: The package may publish only when the release lead approves.
